sourceDesc.p: Vědecká knihovna v Olomouci, M II 153; catalogue vkol000759929. Source EX/M_II_153____2Y2A3I8EX0032R.TIF; SHA256 d8a2a575b79360d76dcc2404de9889b9f82129fa0642bf3aadda72b6c2ddc5d5. Supplier MD5 mismatch unresolved.

encodingDesc.p: Raw model strings preserved without Unicode normalization. Segment IDs retain physical image alignment; Small fragments, boundary segments, tables and ornament may require segmentation review. No word-level geometry or human-verified readings.

Web presentation derivative. Facsimile graphic URI resolves to the public tiled manuscript viewer, not to a standalone bitmap or the archival TIFF. Coordinates remain original image pixels; the viewer renders them through Deep Zoom WebP tiles. Original relative graphic URI(s): ../pages/32r/image.png. Source readings and measured zones remain unchanged.
